summary: Frontend-only testing of DealDetails and MapView pages completed. All requested features are implemented and working: always-on inline editing (no edit button), image carousel with navigation arrows, all deal fields visible as inputs, Pipeline/Stage dropdowns, document drag-and-drop zone, and 'View Full Details' navigation. 26/26 data-testid elements verified on DealDetails page.

issues: Carousel prev/next arrows only show when 2+ images uploaded - expected behavior but user should be informed

critical_code_review_comments: All 26 data-testid attributes present in DealDetails.js - excellent testability
MapView.js side panel has 20+ data-testid attributes for robust testing
Auto-save on blur implemented correctly for all inline editable fields
Image upload properly updates both image_urls array and individual image_url field

test_credentials.pattern: Created multiple test users during UI testing: {prefix}_{random}@t.com / TestPass123!

seed_data_creation: Test deals created via UI during testing - automatically cleaned up per user session
context_for_next_testing_agent: DealDetails and MapView pages fully functional. All inline editing, image carousel, pipeline/stage dropdowns, document upload zones working correctly. No Edit button exists - all fields are always-editable inputs as per requirement.

landing_page.details: Landing page loads with 'Get Started' button and 'Login' link

login_signup_flow.details: Sign up tab shows Full Name, Email, Password fields. 'Create Account' button works. Redirects to /dashboard after signup.
